summary: Experienced Human Resources Business Partner with expertise in partnering with Line of Business Leaders to provide guidance on human capital strategies to include, but not limited to, employee relations, talent management, compensation, etc., in order to meet business goals and objectives.

experience.title: HR Partner
responsibilities: Provide strategic HR guidance and oversight for assigned line of business.
Collaborate with senior leadership to influence organizational design and management practices.
Lead project teams on human capital initiatives such as retention, rewards, and performance management.
Coach and develop managers on performance management and HR policies.
Facilitate resolution of complex issues and interpretation of policies.
Partner with stakeholders in integration efforts and workforce initiatives.
Create and facilitate virtual presentations across multiple states and time zones.

experience.title: Associate People Services Officer
responsibilities: Provide strategic HR guidance and oversight for assigned line of business.
Coach and develop managers on performance management.
Facilitate resolution of complex issues and interpretation of policies.
Create and facilitate virtual presentations on policy interpretation, recruiting, compensation tools, and leaves of absence.
Provide consultation to senior management on complex issues.
Advise managers on compensation, review job descriptions, and make salary recommendations.
Interpret and enforce HR policies, including FMLA, ADA, Title VII, and ADEA.
